input.topic: A 10-minute weeknight pasta using only pantry staples

hook: This three-ingredient pantry pasta tastes expensive but costs less than two dollars.
body:
Drop thin spaghetti into salted boiling water. It only needs six minutes. While it cooks, thinly slice four garlic cloves.

Put the garlic in a cold pan with a generous pour of olive oil and a pinch of red pepper flakes.

Turn the heat to medium. Starting cold infuses the oil deeply without burning the garlic. Now, scoop out a mug of that cloudy pasta water.

Add the pasta and half a cup of that water to your oil. Shake the pan fast. The starch binds the oil and water into a creamy sauce.

You do not need heavy cream or jarred sauce when basic kitchen science does the work for you.
cta: Save this video for the next night you look at an empty fridge and want takeout.

meta.angle: You can create a luxurious, glossy pasta sauce in ten minutes using just garlic, olive oil, and the starch from your pasta water.
